Question:
Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

WITH chars AS (
    SELECT words, pos, substr(words, pos, 1) as c
    FROM word_list 
    CROSS JOIN unnest(generate_series(1, 5)) as gs(pos)
    WHERE words LIKE 'r%' AND LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND pos <= LENGTH(words)
),
sorted_chars AS (
    SELECT words, c
    FROM chars
    ORDER BY words, c
),
word_signature AS (
    SELECT words, 
           string_agg(c, '') as sorted_chars
    FROM sorted_chars
    GROUP BY words
)
SELECT words, sorted_chars FROM word_signature WHERE sorted_chars = 'aadr'

WITH candidate_words AS (
    SELECT words, LENGTH(words) as len, SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) as first_char
    FROM word_list
    WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
    AND SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) = 'r'
),
word_chars AS (
    SELECT words, len, first_char, SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) as ch FROM candidate_words
    UNION ALL
    SELECT words, len, first_char, SUBSTR(words, 2, 1) as ch FROM candidate_words
    UNION ALL
    SELECT words, len, first_char, SUBSTR(words, 3, 1) as ch FROM candidate_words
    UNION ALL
    SELECT words, len, first_char, SUBSTR(words, 4, 1) as ch FROM candidate_words
    UNION ALL
    SELECT words, len, first_char, SUBSTR(words, 5, 1) as ch FROM candidate_words
),
words_with_signature AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        len,
        first_char,
        STRING_AGG(ch, '' ORDER BY ch) as sorted_letters
    FROM word_chars
    GROUP BY words, len, first_char
),
signature_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        sorted_letters,
        COUNT(*) as word_count
    FROM words_with_signature
    GROUP BY sorted_letters
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    w.words,
    (s.word_count - 1) as anagram_count
FROM words_with_signature w
JOIN signature_groups s ON w.sorted_letters = s.sorted_letters
ORDER BY w.words
LIMIT 20

WITH word_letters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        words,
        LENGTH(words) as len,
        pos,
        SUBSTR(words, pos, 1) as letter
    FROM word_list
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(words))) as t(pos)
),
letter_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        len,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_a,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'b' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_b,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_c,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'd' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_d
    FROM word_letters
    GROUP BY words, len
),
word_sigs AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        len,
        cnt_a || cnt_b || cnt_c || cnt_d as partial_sig
    FROM letter_counts
    WHERE len IN (4, 5)
    AND SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) = 'r'
    AND cnt_a = 2 AND cnt_d = 1
)
SELECT words, len, partial_sig FROM word_sigs ORDER BY words
